title: ywec.d: node.rs:387 DAO origin pin lookup derives IID from routable origin
description: Child of project-LICHEN-worker6-ywec. lichen-node/src/node.rs:387 handle_dao does iid = origin[8..] then announces.pinned_pubkey_for(&iid). Post-AddrForKey the DAO origin is a routable /128 whose low 64 bits are NOT the SHA-512 IID, so the indexed pin lookup misses and pinned-key verification degrades to the bounded-snapshot fallback (or fails). Pin store itself is correctly keyed by SHA-512 IID (identity handle). Fix needs an origin->pubkey resolution path that does not assume IID embedding: e.g. scan bounded known_originators snapshot matching ygg_addr_from_pubkey(candidate) == origin. RELATED but distinct: plqy (spec decision on DAO transit-parent naming) and 7ecb (lichen-core iid_from_pubkey correlation). Entangled with i72x.6 vector regen (dao_origin_signature.json) - coordinate before changing observable DAO admission behavior.
